data.title: Bitcoin sinks below 70k, set for deep weekly loss as crypto appetite sours
data.description: Investing.com-- Bitcoin tumbled to a near three-month low on Friday as growing bets on more interest rate hikes and concerns over Strategy’s removal from MSCI indexes dented appetite for cryptocurrencies.
